title: DreamLite: Unified On-Device Image Generation and Editing
summary: A compact 0.39B parameter diffusion model designed by ByteDance for mobile hardware. It utilizes a unified architecture to perform both text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing on-device.
research_notes: Developed by ByteDance Intelligent Creation Lab; introduces in-context spatial concatenation to merge generation and editing workflows.

evolution.summary: The inference code was released in April 2026 via the ByteVisionLab GitHub organization. The model currently achieves real-time performance on smartphones through 4-step distillation and a pruned mobile U-Net backbone.
